item.title: This Day in New Jersey History — November 28: Washington's army passes through Woodbridge
item.description: On November 28–29, 1776, George Washington and the Continental Army passed through Woodbridge during their retreat toward New Brunswick. Source: Woodbridge historical marker (https://www.hmdb.org/m.asp?m=306572)
